about: The map's table of contents (0.2 map line, 2026-11-20): every class of thing in the system and the one table that is its source. 'reader' is the package that loads the source; the class belongs to that package's domain in config/domain-ownership.json. 'also' are other places that say the same class: each is a second source to merge into the first or to generate from it. A class with no source is 'unmeasured', not empty.

classes.what: the domains, their tier and contracts
classes.live: the seat roster's domain ids, read each round
classes.note: 2026-11-23: each round the map compares the table's domains with the seats that sit them (seats.yaml domain_id and also_domain_ids): a domain no owner seat sits (status checks)

classes.what: who owns each Go package of the platform
who owns code outside the Go packages and the console groups (mcp/, agent/, scripts/, config files, root files)
classes.note: the paths section; a Go package is covered only by its package row

classes.what: who owns each front-end directory of the console
what no row covers, with first-seen time and review
classes.note: the pool itself is kept by the scan (statefile catalog/unperceived-<repo>); the file holds the claim (with the proposed domain), delete and unknown verdicts, each with a reason

classes.what: the event types on the bus and who subscribes
classes.live: the event types the ledger holds events of in the last seven days, read each round
classes.note: 2026-11-22: each round the map compares the declared types (the bus's topics and the ledger's own) with the types written in the last seven days: written but not declared, declared but silent in the window (status checks)

classes.what: the MCP tools the platform's servers register and the domain whose contract offers each
classes.live: the tools registered in mcp/<server>/src (reg, registerTool, server.tool), read each round
classes.note: 2026-11-22 (compute line, Foundation): each round the map compares the registered tools with the domains' contracts (commands of kind mcp_tool): tools in no contract, contract entries with no tool (status checks)

classes.what: the Prometheus recording and alerting rules (bifrost_node:home_info, ComputePain…), by rule group
classes.live: the rule groups Prometheus has loaded (/api/v1/rules), read each round
classes.note: 2026-11-22 (compute line, Foundation): each round the map compares the PrometheusRule manifests' groups under the source directory with the groups Prometheus has loaded: loaded but declared by no manifest there (a chart's defaults, a rule applied by hand), declared but not loaded (status checks). The manifest files themselves are owned by the infra table's path rows.

classes.what: the catalogued actions and their tiers
classes.live: the actions the running platform serves, read each round
classes.note: 2026-11-23: each round the map compares the actions the catalog file on main lists with the actions the running platform serves (status checks); the file and the code are also held equal by actions' own test

classes.what: the machines of the cluster and their roles
classes.live: the cluster's node list (internal IP and name), read each round
also: compute line's home table (outside this repository)
classes.note: the map compares the machines topology.yaml marks in_k3s_cluster with the cluster's nodes by IP (status checks: not registered, not live); machines outside the cluster are only registered

classes.what: dev, stg, prod and how to reach them
classes.live: the cluster's namespaces, read each round
classes.note: 2026-11-22: each round the map compares the namespace each environment names with the cluster's namespaces (status checks); an environment with no namespace (a thin client) is not compared

classes.what: the clusters the platform reads
classes.live: the cluster's namespaces, read each round
classes.note: 2026-11-22: each round the map compares each cluster's bifrost_namespaces with the namespaces the cluster has: namespaces not registered (the system's own among them), registered namespaces that are not there (status checks)

classes.what: which image runs where
classes.live: the deployments the cluster scan saw each round
classes.note: 2026-11-22: each round the map compares the deployments each release lane lists with the deployments the cluster scan saw (status checks); the file names no images, so which image runs is not compared

classes.what: the local dev services (bdev)
the Trade API's route groups the probes read
the lines (seats): who sits each, its domain, owner or temporary, harness, session, mailbox; and each seat's identity card
classes.live: the charter pages beside the roster, listed each round
classes.note: a table since 2026-11-21 (Crew). Each round the map compares it with the charter pages beside it and the platform domain ids, Crew's measure (status checks: pages with no row, rows with no page, unknown domain ids, temporary seats nobody invited); check-seats.py is the same by hand. Cards are column 2-6 of each row (render-card.py). brain/company-map.md is the old hand list.

classes.what: the repositories of the system
also: config/catalog-review.json repositories (the map's claim of each repository; the registry's domain column follows it)
classes.note: the registry is Foundation's (R0B 2026-11-23: one list of repositories, one row each with tier, domain, public, ready, purpose); each round the map compares it with the Gitea organization (status checks: listed but not registered, registered but not listed, tier retired not expected; a domain that differs from the map's claim is a problem). A repository with no ownership table is listed by directory in the pool; a tenant's is kept as one entry (LAW-10)
classes.live: the Gitea organization's repositories (non-archived, non-empty), listed each round

classes.what: the platform database's tables and who owns each
classes.note: the tables section: a schema row covers its tables, a <schema>/<table> row one table; what no row covers is in the pool of repository "platform-db". The platform's own database only (LAW-10); the tenants' are tenant-data-table
classes.live: the tables of the platform's database (pg_tables of the agentrt environment's database), listed each round

classes.what: what runs in the cluster (namespace/workload)
classes.note: the workloads section: a namespace row covers its workloads, a <namespace>/<name> row one workload (the run key agreed with the metrics line); what no row covers is in the pool of repository "cluster"
classes.live: the cluster's workloads (Deployments, StatefulSets, DaemonSets, CronJobs of every namespace), listed each round

classes.what: the Trade, Research and Finance databases' tables
classes.note: not read this round: the tenants have databases of their own, apart from the platform's; the platform's own first (ISSUE-71)
